test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II (Statistics) Official Paper-II (Held On: 19 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a good characteristic of a questionnaire?

options.text: Questions should proceed in logical sequence from easy to more difficult.
Technical terms and vague expressions should be avoided.
Personal and intimate questions should be put in the beginning.
Questionnaire should be comparatively short and simple.

solution:
A **good questionnaire **is designed to make respondents comfortable and encourage accurate responses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Questions should move from **easy to difficult **to build confidence.
